snippet.title: Fixer Undercover - Official Early Access Release Window Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Fixer Undercover is a narrative-driven VR puzzle adventure that blends escape-room mechanics with a spy thriller atmosphere. While other agents have gadgets, you have a screwdriver and your creativity. As Agent 404, you must infiltrate the high-security Redemption Prison disguised as a maintenance worker to expose the dark truth behind Warden Kozlov’s "Born Again" rehabilitation program. Accompanied by Winston, your chatty and high-strung drone partner, you’ll use real-world tools to hack systems and solve environmental puzzles. Get another look at the Fixer Undercover trailer to see gameplay and more. Fixer Undercover will be available on Early Access on Meta Quest in January 2026.
